name: guardrails
description: Turns your written repo rules into hard tool-call denials: protected branches, .env files, read-only and consent-gated repos, branch locks, blocked commands and commits outside worktrees, with session-scoped consent typed at the prompt.

workspaceRoot.title: Workspace root
workspaceRoot.description: The folder that holds your repos; a leading ~ is your home folder. Empty turns off every rule that needs it: read-only and consent-gated repos, branch locks, primary-checkout commits and recursive-search limits.

worktreesDir.title: Worktrees folder
worktreesDir.description: Name of the folder directly under the workspace root that holds your git worktrees. Commits there are allowed.

protectedBranches.title: Protected branches
protectedBranches.description: Comma-separated branch names. No direct push to them, no gh pr merge into them, no local commit, merge, rebase or reset while one is checked out, and no local delete or rename.

primaryCommits.title: Commits in primary checkouts
primaryCommits.description: block: commits in a repo under the workspace root but outside the worktrees folder need /consent primary-commit. allow: no check. Needs a workspace root.

readOnlyRepos.title: Read-only repos
readOnlyRepos.description: Comma-separated folder names directly under the workspace root that are never written. No consent unlocks them.

consentRepos.title: Consent-gated repos
consentRepos.description: Comma-separated folder names directly under the workspace root. Reading one needs /consent <folder>; committing or pushing in it needs /consent <folder>-write.

branchLocks.title: Branch locks
branchLocks.description: Comma-separated folder=branch pairs. That repo may not create or switch to any other branch.

blockedCommands.title: Blocked commands
blockedCommands.description: Comma-separated program names that are never run, however they are wrapped (sudo, env, sh -c, xargs and so on).

envFiles.title: .env files
envFiles.description: block: .env, .env.* and *.env files are never read, written or named; .env.example, .env.sample and .env.template pass. allow: no check.

protectedPaths.title: Protected paths
protectedPaths.description: Comma-separated files or folders (~ allowed) that need /consent self-edit to change, on top of this plugin's folder, installed plugins and enabledPlugins in settings.json.

ownerName.title: Owner name
ownerName.description: Who deny messages tell Claude to ask, as in "Ask <name> to run /consent ...".
